steps.do: Find every personal checking account that passes all four checks. (1) Tenure: the referrer's tenure meets the account's minimum (Light Green 14 days; Blue, Green, Green Fee-Free, Light Blue, Gold Years 30; Dark Green, Evergreen, Purple 45; Bluest 60). (2) Deposit: the planned new-money deposit meets the account's qualifying deposit (Light Green $100, Green Fee-Free $300, Blue/Green/Light Blue $500, Evergreen $750, Dark Green/Purple/Gold Years $1,000, Bluest $2,000), and for Bluest also its $75,000 opening deposit. (3) Age: the referred person's age fits (Light Green 13-24, Dark Green 17-26, Gold Years 62+, all others 18+). (4) Cap: this year's referrals of that type are below its annual cap. The account types the referrer holds do not matter. Among the accounts that pass, recommend the one with the highest referrer + referred bonus, and state both amounts.
steps.if: the customer is eligible and the referral is for a personal checking account

steps.do: Keep only the business checking programs that pass three checks: the referred deposit meets the required deposit, the referrer's tenure meets the minimum, and the referrer's referrals for that type this calendar year are below its annual cap. Drop Sky Blue unless the business is within 4 years of formation. The account types the referrer already holds do not matter. Recommend the program with the highest referrer bonus, unless apply_business_promotion applies; in that case it decides the order.

steps.do: Check the current date against the business checking promotion notices. 11/01/2025 to 11/30/2025: recommend Sky Blue first, then Lime Green, and other programs only if neither passes. 10/12/2025 to 11/12/2025: Lime Green first, then Hunter Green, then others. If several programs pass every check in choose_account, recommend the highest-priority promotional one that passes. Never recommend a promotional program that fails a check: for example, Sky Blue for a business more than 4 years from formation, Lime Green for a deposit below $15,000, or a program at its annual cap. If no notice is active, keep choose_account's highest-referrer-bonus pick.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, or told they could not be verified. Their referral history (9-day window and per-type annual counts) and account tenure have been checked from the records, and any of their own figures that differ from the records have been corrected. Then one of three outcomes holds. (a) The customer was told the referral cannot be submitted now and why: rolling window full, tenure too short, same registered address, referred party not new or same business owner, signer under 18, or no program's deposit, cap or age rule met. No recommendation was given and nothing was submitted. (b) The customer was told the eligible account to use (personal: highest combined bonus; business: highest referrer bonus, or the active promotion's priority among programs that pass every check), with both bonus amounts, the qualifying deposit and its window, and the conditions. They have submitted submit_referral with that account type ending in 'Account' (or know to do so), and the result has been explained. (c) For several parties: each party has a recommended account or a reason it has none. The customer has submitted no more referrals than there are open slots, prioritized by their goal. For each party still waiting, they know the account to use and when a slot opens.

open_questions: The October 2025 notice (10/12/2025-11/12/2025) and the November 2025 notice (11/01/2025-11/30/2025) overlap from 11/01 to 11/12 and give different orders. The documents do not say which one wins.

The documents do not say whether a promotion's priority overrides a customer's stated goal of the highest bonus when several business programs pass every check. This workflow applies the promotion order among programs that meet every check.

When only one slot is open and the customer wants the highest bonus, the documents give no tie-break for a program near its annual cap or close to year-end (for example, the last Sky Blue slot of the year).
The window counts 'referral bonuses' by timestamp. The documents do not say whether NO_PROGRESS, APPLIED or IN_PROGRESS referrals count toward the 9-day window or the annual caps.
No tool reads a referred business's formation date or a referred person's age. The agent relies on what the customer says, confirmed by asking.
No document describes submit_referral's output. The 'Account' suffix comes from the account-name rule.

steps.do: Greet the customer. Ask for their name or email and for any two of: date of birth, email, phone number, address.
steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Look up the customer's record with the identifier they gave: get_user_information_by_name (case sensitive), get_user_information_by_email, or get_user_information_by_id.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or email / user_id with the matching tool)

steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Compare the customer's two verification values with the record. If fewer than 2 match, do not share or discuss any account or referral details, and ask again. If the customer still cannot verify, offer a transfer to a human agent.
steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Get the current date and time. It is used for the verification log, the 9-day window, the calendar-year caps, tenure and which promotion is active.
steps.quote: A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: Log the verification with the record's name, user_id, address, email, phone_number and date_of_birth, and the current time.
steps.if: check_identity passed (2 or more values match)
steps.quote: Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first

steps.do: Read all referrals the verified customer has made: date, account type and status.
steps.quote: Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool.
steps.if: customer verified and the tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's bank accounts: account_type, account_class, status, balance and date_opened.
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Count the customer's referrals dated within the 9 days before the current time. Count every account type together and leave out REJECTED ones. Open slots = 2 minus that count. If the customer's stated last-referral date differs from the records, politely correct them with the record date. If there are 0 open slots, explain that more referrals now would be automatically denied. Tell them when a slot opens: when the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old. Then stop. Make no recommendation and give no submit instruction.
steps.quote: You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

steps.do: Find the earliest date_opened among the customer's checking accounts and compute the days up to the current time. Mark each program whose referrer tenure threshold is not met as unavailable. The thresholds are in rules. The type of account the customer holds does not matter.
steps.if: check_rolling_window found at least 1 open slot
steps.quote: Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.

steps.do: For each candidate account type, count the customer's referrals of that type in the current calendar year. Mark any program at or over its annual maximum (see rules) as unavailable. If the customer's stated counts differ from the records, politely correct them.
steps.if: check_rolling_window found at least 1 open slot
steps.quote: **Annual maximum**: 6 referral bonuses per calendar year

steps.do: For each person or business, ask for anything not yet given: age (individuals), formation or incorporation date (businesses), planned new-money deposit, any existing Rho-Bank account or one closed within 12 months, same address as the customer, and (businesses) whether the primary signer already owns a Rho-Bank business account. Also ask what the customer wants to prioritize.
steps.if: check_rolling_window found at least 1 open slot
steps.quote: The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.

steps.do: For each referred party, drop it if it is not a new customer, shares the customer's address, or (business) has the same primary owner by SSN as an existing Rho-Bank business account. Then list the accounts it qualifies for: by age (62+ Gold Years; 17-26 Dark Green; 13-24 Light Green; others 18+), by formation (Sky Blue within 4 years), and by planned deposit meeting each program's qualifying deposit. Keep only accounts that check_tenure and check_annual_caps left available.
steps.quote: The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.

steps.do: For business referrals, find the promotion active on the current date. 11/01/2025-11/30/2025: Sky Blue first, Lime Green second. 10/12/2025-11/12/2025: Lime Green first, Hunter Green second. If several eligible accounts meet ALL of the customer's stated requirements, recommend in that order. Never recommend a promotional account that fails a requirement. If no promotion is active, recommend the account that best meets the customer's stated requirements.
steps.if: at least one referred party is a business with more than one eligible account
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: If the customer wants more referrals than there are open slots, recommend submitting only as many as there are open slots now. Pick the referral(s) whose recommended account pays the highest referrer bonus, or follow the customer's own stated priority. For the rest, give the recommended account and the date the window reopens. Any referral beyond the open slots would be automatically denied and cannot be reinstated in that window.
steps.if: number of eligible referrals the customer wants is greater than the open slots
steps.quote: If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.

steps.do: Tell the customer which account to use for each referral that can go now and why: referrer bonus, the referred party's bonus, qualifying deposit and window. The deposit must be new money (not from another Rho-Bank account) and stay at least 30 days after the qualifying period; closing within 90 days may claw back the bonus. If a referred party qualifies for no available account, say so and why. Tell the customer to run submit_referral with their own user_id and the full account name ending in 'Account' (e.g. 'Sky Blue Account').
steps.if: at least one referral is eligible and an open slot exists
steps.quote: Personal checking account_class options must use the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g., 'Blue Account', 'Green Account (checking)').

steps.do: The customer submits each recommended referral that fits the open slots, and no more.

args.account_type: the recommended account's full name ending in 'Account'

steps.if: the customer chooses to submit
steps.quote: You can have multiple referrals in progress, but you can only receive a maximum of 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.

steps.do: If the customer reports a REJECTED or ERROR result, explain the likely reason (window limit or an eligibility issue) and do not tell them to retry right away. For a window rejection, give the date the oldest referral passes 9 days. For the remaining referrals, restate the recommended accounts and when they can be submitted.
steps.if: the customer reports a submission result or asks about the remaining referrals
steps.quote: If your referral was rejected due to the rolling window limit, you must wait until your oldest qualifying referral is more than 9 days old.

steps.do: Transfer to a human agent only if the request is outside what the documents cover and the customer agrees, or the customer asks for a human 4 times. Use the reason code that fits best, for example request_completed_customer_wants_human_followup or customer_requests_human_no_specific_reason.

args.summary: short summary of the referral request and what was done
args.reason: reason code from the transfer reason table

steps.if: the customer asks for a human and the policy transfer conditions are met
steps.quote: When using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, select the most accurate reason code from the tiered list below.

rules.rule: No recommendation or referral-terms information is given until the customer's referral eligibility (window, tenure, caps) has been checked from records.

rules.rule: At most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window, across all checking account types. The third and later referrals in the window are automatically denied.
rules.quote: This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.

rules.rule: Referrals auto-denied by the window cannot be reinstated in the same window. The customer must wait until the oldest referral in the window is more than 9 days old.
rules.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

rules.rule: Tenure is measured from the date_opened of the customer's earliest checking account, whatever account type they hold now.
rules.quote: Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.

rules.rule: The referred party must be new to Rho-Bank (no existing account, and no closed account within 12 months) and must not share the referrer's address.
rules.quote: The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.

rules.rule: The referred business's primary owner (by SSN of the primary authorized signer) must differ from that of any existing Rho-Bank business account.
rules.quote: For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.
